items.statement: Generated operating cash flow of INR122 crores in FY23 and repaid INR75 crores of borrowings in first six months of FY24
items.quote: We believe in financial discipline and the company has judicially utilized cash towards lowering debt from INR 107 crores in March '23 to INR 26 crores as of September '23 and generated cash flow from operation of INR122 crores in FY'23 which allow us to reinvest this in new market and products.

items.statement: Metro Cast acquisition stake increased to 50.1% in Q4 FY24, consolidation started from Q2 FY24 at 34% stake
items.quote: This quarter we have as per the agreement and all we have increased our stake to 50.1% now in the Company.

items.statement: Metro Cast added 4.5 lakh subscribers to consolidated base of 9.5 million
items.quote: Yes, it's like 4.4 to 4.5 lakhs which is there in 9.5 million which we have given. So, 4.5 lakh subscriber has come from the Metro Cast.

items.statement: Operating cash flow impacted by project working capital, margin money and OD utilization for BharatNet project
items.quote: Yes. So, you will see that there is an increase in borrowing. This is mainly due to the project we have to give some margin money and we hav e to utilize our limits, the OD limits fully and because of that you will see there is an increase in the borrowing right now

items.statement: Trade receivables and payables both increased ~80% from broadcaster pay-channel transactions
items.quote: Yes it's trade receivable is both the trade receivables and payable is almost both side around 80% is the increase that is 80% is from the pay channel from the broadcasts.

items.statement: No fresh equity issuance mentioned; Metro Cast acquisition funded via cash and STB boxes recorded as investment not CAPEX
items.quote: No, whatever we did that is coming under the investment in our books right now and from next year onwards we are going to go for the CAPEX and all because the deal as you can see there that was to give him the cheque or cash for 25 crore plus the boxes of 2.30 lakh that's why. So, those all have gone into the investment right now.

name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd

items.statement: Advances received for projects increased to almost INR900 crores, driving the rise in other current liabilities
items.quote: The increase in other current liabilities is essentially because of advances received for projects to the tune of almost INR900 crores.

items.statement: Preferential debt from group company reduced from INR150 crores to INR95 crores; priority to repay it first.
items.quote: So, the preferential debt was INR150 crores as on last year, which has come down to INR95 crores.

items.statement: Working capital requirement increased by INR70-100 crores due to higher operations and new products.
items.quote: And working capital also, since we have increased our operations drastically, so our working capital requirement also has gone up compared to last year and this year in the range of around INR70 to INR100 crores.

items.statement: Revenue from Meghmani Organics is 10-11% of total revenue.
items.quote: I mean when I say 10% to 11% that will be of the total revenue.

items.statement: Liquid balance of close to Rs.280 crore as on March 31st with near nil borrowings
items.quote: With good efforts on inventory and debtors, we have close to Rs.280 crore of liquid balance as on March 31st, with near nil borrowings.

items.statement: Received INR3.27 crore subsidy installment in March 2024; five more annual installments expected
items.quote: INR3.27 crores. That was a capex we had done three years back to expand our capacity in Pithampur plant where we were sanctioned a total subsidy of INR22 -odd crores, which is to be paid to us in eight years' time. So out of eight years, we have received the third installment on 31st March. Shridhar Kallani: Okay. Sunil Chordia: So for next five years, we will get similar

items.statement: ECL provisions for non-Mahindra 3PL receivables are 0.3% to 0.4% on Rs 500-600 crore exposure
items.quote: At an overall level our ECL dock, our non-Mahindra supply chain, 3PL supply chain receivables level is between Rs 500 crores to Rs 600 crores and our ECL provisions around 0.3% to 0.4%.

items.statement: ESOP pool is 2% of equity with 30-40% utilized; small P&L charge this year
items.quote: No, the total, overall budget is 2%. U tilization is not even 30%-40% till now
